q: Is chilled water bought from a district cooling plant Scope 2?
title: District cooling and Scope 2
short: Yes. Purchased cooling is Scope 2, like purchased electricity and steam. Ask the provider for the emissions per unit of cooling, usually per TR-hour or kWh of cooling, based on their electricity and fuel. Without it, estimate from their chiller efficiency and the grid factor, and label it an estimate.
audience: Offices, IT parks and campuses on district cooling

ul: Cooling delivered to you per month, from the meter.
Their plant electricity and fuel per unit of cooling.
Refrigerant top-ups, which they report in their own Scope 1.

sections.h: If you get only a bill in rupees
p: Ask for the metered TR-hours. A rupee-based estimate is weak evidence and verifiers will ask for the meter data.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
